display.purpose: Page welcomes and section marque only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e0c264; color: #17131f; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 600 0.9375rem 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b89eef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary: cancel, demo, selector trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #a0a0b8; border: 1px solid #3a3a55; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 400 0.9375rem 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color .18s, border-color .18s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #e0e0e0; border-color: #b39642; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b89eef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Forge Card
components.description: Raised archive panel: seal + forge name + one-line description.
components.html: TCodexBuild interconnected lore.
components.css: .ds-forge { display: grid; gap: 10px; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; grid-template-areas: 'seal name' 'seal desc'; align-content: start; padding: 24px 20px; background: #2a2a44; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #3a3a55; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .18s, transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-forge:hover { border-color: #b39642; } .ds-forge .ds-seal { grid-area: seal; } .ds-forge-name { grid-area: name; font: 600 1.375rem 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-forge-desc { grid-area: desc; color: #a0a0b8; font-size: .875rem; }

components.name: Wax Seal
components.description: Gold wax circle with engraved initial; marks the archive.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 30%, #d8b23a, #a3831e 62%, #7d6416); color: #241c08; font: 700 20px 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .15) inset, 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / .5); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Ink well with hairline border; labels uppercase.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 600 .75rem 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a0a0b8; } .ds-field input { background: #1a1a2e; color: #e0e0e0; border: 1px solid #3a3a55; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 .9375rem 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #b39642; outline: none; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Night well floating over a dim scrim; destructive confirm included.
components.html:
Delete "Vellmora"?

This removes the world and everything in it. No going back.
components.css: .ds-modal { background: #16162a; border: 1px solid #3a3a55; border-radius: 8px; width: min(440px, 92vw); padding: 18px; display: grid; gap: 10px; color: #e0e0e0; font: 400 .9375rem 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(10 10 18 / .5); } .ds-modal-title { font: 600 1.375rem 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-modal p { color: #a0a0b8; margin: 0; } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-ghost, .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-primary { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-primary { background: #e0c264; color: #17131f; border: 0; } .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #a0a0b8; border: 1px solid #3a3a55; } .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #f44336; border: 1px solid #f44336; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; }

narrative.overview: Deep ink-navy surfaces with parchment text and gold seals mark the system. The archive identity comes from composition: serif display type, hairline rules and stamped seals instead of glow and gradients.
